Source: R/create_rgee_environment.R
create_ad4gd_env.Rd

Create AD4GD Environment for Google Earth Engine Satellite Data

Usage

create_ad4gd_env(force = FALSE, debug = FALSE)

Arguments

force

force installation even if already installed

debug

print debug messages (default: FALSE)

Value

python environment required for R package "rgee"
